name: Stroke
description: Stroke/: StrokeSample (point, pressure, time) and the strokeSamples fixture (40 samples), StrokeSegment (a cubic with a pressure range), StrokeSmoother (samples to segments one late, flattening), DabSpacer (dab centres between two points), BrushSettings with BrushEdit (size, hardness, opacity, flow, spacing, clamped), BrushPreset, and LiveCopy, the working copy a drag draws on until take(). EK-29 declares them as stubs; EK-28 fills the bodies.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials) and FlareCore, Linux and macOS
